diagnosis: The viewset configures IsAuthorOrReadOnly on personal mental health journal entries. Because the permission class treats all SAFE_METHODS (GET, HEAD, OPTIONS) as universally permitted, any authenticated user can view, list, and read intimate mental health journal entries belonging to any other patient.
exploit_request:
GET /api/therapy/journals/4812/ HTTP/1.1
Host: health.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
